declarations.name: ClassTransformOptions

members.name: strategy
members.doc: Exclusion strategy. By default exposeAll is used, which means that it will expose all properties are transformed by default.

members.name: excludeExtraneousValues
members.doc: Indicates if extraneous properties should be excluded from the value when converting a plain value to a class.

members.name: groups
members.doc: Only properties with given groups gonna be transformed.

members.name: version
members.doc: Only properties with "since" > version < "until" gonna be transformed.

members.name: excludePrefixes
members.doc: Excludes properties with the given prefixes. For example, if you mark your private properties with "_" and "__" you can set this option's value to ["_", "__"] and all private properties will be skippe

members.name: ignoreDecorators
members.doc: If set to true then class transformer will ignore the effect of all

members.name: targetMaps
members.doc: Target maps allows to set a Types of the transforming object without using

members.name: enableCircularCheck
members.doc: If set to true then class transformer will perform a circular check. (circular check is turned off by default) This option is useful when you know for sure that your types might have a circular depend

members.name: enableImplicitConversion
members.doc: If set to true then class transformer will try to convert properties implicitly to their target type based on their typing information.

members.name: exposeDefaultValues
members.doc: If set to true then class transformer will take default values for unprovided fields. This is useful when you convert a plain object to a class and have an optional field with a default value.

members.name: exposeUnsetFields
members.doc: When set to true, fields with `undefined` as value will be included in class to plain transformation. Otherwise those fields will be omitted from the result.

declarations.doc: Options to be passed during transformation.

members.name: instanceToPlain
members.doc: Converts class (constructor) object to plain (literal) object. Also works with arrays.

members.name: classToPlainFromExist
members.doc: Converts class (constructor) object to plain (literal) object. Uses given plain object as source object (it means fills given plain object with data from class object). Also works with arrays.

members.name: plainToInstance
members.doc: Converts plain (literal) object to class (constructor) object. Also works with arrays.

members.name: plainToClassFromExist
members.doc: Converts plain (literal) object to class (constructor) object. Uses given object as source object (it means fills given object with data from plain object). Also works with arrays.

members.name: instanceToInstance
members.doc: Converts class (constructor) object to new class (constructor) object. Also works with arrays.

members.name: classToClassFromExist
members.doc: Converts class (constructor) object to plain (literal) object. Uses given plain object as source object (it means fills given plain object with data from class object). Also works with arrays.

members.name: serialize
members.doc: Serializes given object to a JSON string.

members.name: deserialize
members.doc: Deserializes given JSON string to a object of the given class.

members.name: deserializeArray
members.doc: Deserializes given JSON string to an array of objects of the given class.
